tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Find open-source AI projects by what they do, e.g. 'run chat models offline' or 'transcribe audio'. Searches both shelves unless 'shelf' is given: 'ai' (AI tools) or 'ai-integrated' (everyday software that AI assistants can use, e.g. a notes app with an MCP server). tools.description: Full details of one project: what it does, who it's for, whether it needs coding, rating, numbers, license and source links.

tools.description: All categories on both shelves ('ai' and 'ai-integrated') with a short description, how many projects each has, and the slugs of its projects.
